Laos
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Wien):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Lao People’s Democratic Republic are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
